rows.Origin:
Bred by Michèle Meilland Richardier (France, before 2004).
Introduced in France by Meilland International (after 1997) in 2006 as 'Arlequin'.
rows.Bloom: Yellow, orange shading. Moderate fragrance. up to 40 petals. Average diameter 5.25". Very large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, in small clusters, cupped bloom form.
rows.Habit:
Upright. Medium, semi-glossy, medium green foliage.

Height: 35" to 39" (90 to 100cm).
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes: No. 026 in the 2004 Monza Competition (Source: Website Roseto Niso Fumagalli.)
